questions.question: What is the rollback plan after 8.4 has started on a data directory that was on 8.0?
options: Reinstall the 8.0 binaries on the same data directory
Downgrade with a SET GLOBAL command
Restore a backup or use an old-version replica, since major-version downgrade is not supported
questions.explanation: The data dictionary is upgraded, so 8.0 cannot open it. Rollback relies on backups or an old replica.

questions.question: Which 8.0 account setting will stop working by default in 8.4?
questions.explanation: mysql_native_password is disabled by default in 8.4, so affected accounts must be migrated to caching_sha2_password first.

questions.question: Which statement replaces SHOW MASTER STATUS in 8.4?
questions.explanation: SHOW MASTER STATUS was removed; SHOW BINARY LOG STATUS replaces it, and it does not exist in 8.0.

questions.question: Which replication direction is supported for a rolling upgrade?
questions.explanation: Replication from an older source to a newer replica is supported, so upgrade replicas first and then switch over.
